skills.name: analogue-circuit-dsp
skills.description: Develop and review behavioural analogue-circuit models for audio DSP, especially JSFX/EEL2 workbench experiments. Use when translating schematics, measurements, or circuit behaviour into reusable DSP blocks; deciding model boundaries; separating ideal controls from finite analogue stages; modelling rails, feedback, bandwidth, slew, noise, summing, filters, or nonlinearities; and designing validation/null tests. Prefer topology-informed, measurable abstractions over component cosplay, and keep project-specific evidence distinct from general modelling assumptions.
